{{EventSandboxOnly|date=28th of May 2022|event=[[Duck Hunt Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Cart |image1 = MomCart.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] ---- Originally:
[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = N/A |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]25 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |spawned_by = [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Spillage}}''' - Upon its destruction, the '''Cart''' spawns three [[Eggroll]]s. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cart''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though not through [[Logbooks]] as '''Cart''' does not appear in [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. Instead, [[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] has to be summoned to spawn it into the match. It had high health but slightly slow speed. Upon death, it would spawn three [[Eggroll]]s. The '''Cart''' can be spawned by the [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]]. ==Appearance== The '''Cart''' is a light brown wooden cart filled with seven [[Eggroll]]s. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers like the [[Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] fare well against the '''Cart'''. **Multiple [[Sniper]]s are recommended for their long range, letting them defeat the '''Cart''' from further away, making it easier to deal with the [[Eggroll]]s spawned. In addition, the [[Sniper]] can also counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] that debuts later on in the game. *As the '''Cart''' is able to spawn multiple [[Eggroll]]s, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]], are recommended. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''Cart''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHuntPI.png|'''Cart''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Cart''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CartIconIG.png|'''Cart''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Unlike other spawns, the '''Cart''' appeared on the enemy that it spawned from before it dies. This meant that you could damage both the [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] and '''Cart''' at the same time, if you had a tower that hits multiple enemies. *Weirdly, the '''Cart''' contained seven eggs, but when killed it only spawned three [[Eggroll]]s. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Cart''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Cart''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Cart''' can now be appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player summons the legacy [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]]. **{{Bug}} No longer properly positioned behind the [[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]]. **{{Bug}} Sometimes has issues summoning in [[Eggroll]]s. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:D00M's Revenge]]
